method.institution_filter: QS World University Rankings 2027 overall rank <= 100 (ties; 102 institutions)

channels.csrankings: CSRankings faculty file; DBLP names; current affiliation; DBLP-derived main-track counts
channels.openreview_self_reported: accepted ICLR/NeurIPS/ICML authors whose OpenReview profile lists a (non-adjunct, non-visiting, non-emeritus) professor title at a QS top-100 institution in 2023 or later
channels.seed_dossier: 2026-10-26 verified witness papers used as identity anchors

method.list_a_rule: a main-track paper at each of NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV
method.list_b_rule: List A + a main-track paper at ECCV
method.venue_presence: CSRankings count > 0, or a strongly attributed accepted-paper witness, or a 2026-10-26 dossier witness outside paper-list coverage
method.topic_rule: topic_score >= 3.0: weighted count of accepted six-venue papers whose own title/keywords match the ontology (3D and safety weigh 0.5; abstract-only matches half)
method.identity_rule: seed title, affiliation/domain, DBLP id, >=2 co-author overlap, or exact rare name; a conflicting DBLP id rejects the occurrence

evidence_levels.V1: every required venue has a primary-proceedings link with strong identity
evidence_levels.V2: some required venues rest on DBLP-derived counts or dossier witnesses
evidence_levels.R1: CSRankings affiliation + OpenReview professor title reported in 2024+
evidence_levels.R2: one of: CSRankings affiliation, OpenReview self-report, dossier
evidence_levels.E2: V1 or R1 (compatible with the 2026-10-26 rubric)

qs_institutions_without_csrankings: The London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)
King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (KFUPM)

caveats: CSRankings covers faculty who can advise CS PhD students; the OpenReview channel adds self-reported professors but only for people who publish at OpenReview venues and keep profiles current.
Affiliations can lag moves; self-reported titles are not official appointments. Check the official faculty page before outreach (the harness 'verify-roles' command does this on your machine).

Self-reported professors whose later OpenReview records show another role are excluded; where CSRankings lists a self-reported professor at another institution, the entry is kept with an affiliation_note to verify. Decisions: self_report_conflicts.csv.
A person with appointments at two QS universities can appear once per institution when the sources cannot prove it is the same person (no shared DBLP id), e.g. Yi Ma (UC Berkeley, HKU).
Learned DBLP ids must agree with CSRankings' DBLP disambiguation number; this keeps namesakes' papers apart (e.g. Bo Li 0001 at HKUST vs Bo Li 0026 at UIUC).
Paper Copilot coverage: NeurIPS 2010-2025, ICML 2017-2026, ICLR 2013-2026, CVPR 2017-2025, ICCV 2017-2025, ECCV 2018-2024. Other years rely on CSRankings counts or dossier witnesses.
Topic tags come from paper titles/keywords; they describe published output, not expertise.
Citation sums are Google Scholar snapshots stored by Paper Copilot; indicators, not rankings.
QS ranks institutions, not people; 'renowned' is represented only by transparent indicators.
